curated-gf-allura-gf-della-respira: Della Respira stands upright and editorial, its capitals towering over the lowercase. Allura's smooth, tightly huddled pen script against that serif is the pair's whole charm, handy for a quick paragraph or, say, a cute bakery storefront.
curated-gf-alumni-sans-inline-one-noto-s: Noto Serif reads warm and literary, with a prominent x-height. Alumni Sans Inline One's narrow counters and hairline joins could headline a dark fantasy game title; the serif stays sturdy across longer text, though brief copy suits it best.
curated-gf-amarante-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab is bookish and stretched out, with open counters. Amarante curls its closed, softly swelling curves into a commanding headline, while the slab, drawn with compass-pencil consistency, stays pleasant in modest helpings.
curated-gf-angkor-gf-arsenal: Arsenal moves along friendly and close-knit, its x-height nearly touching cap height, pleasant over a few paragraphs (gothic cafe signage, say). Angkor's closed, stencil-spaced letters loom over Arsenal's open, approachable lines.
curated-gf-anton-sc-fs-erode: Packed and towering, Anton SC crams a near-capital lowercase into crowded lines with ribbon-narrow e's (a student id card, say). Anton does punch; Erode, a text serif, does the patient reading.
curated-gf-arapey-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Literary and refined, Arapey wears hairline serifs on heavy stems. Noto Sans Khojki does the plain talking, its wide exits and generous e's letting light through, where Arapey does the dense, compact lines.
curated-gf-arapey-gf-radley: Radley sounds authoritative, with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns. Arapey, sharper and more sparkling with its hairline serifs, stands next to it like a literary cousin, a touch showier but clearly from the same bookshelf.
curated-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-h: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws each stroke like drawn cable, fine for a cannabis dispensary logo. Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its big open counters friendly, so paragraphs stay easygoing even at tiny sizes.
curated-gf-averia-gruesa-libre-gf-noto-s: Distinctive and expressive, Averia Gruesa Libre keeps contrast gentle. Noto Sans New Tai Lue cups its round letters softly, so text flows pleasantly in light servings, say on a set of fitness app workout cards.
curated-gf-averia-libre-gf-arvo: Arvo reads traditional and dignified, with curves that refuse to close. Averia Libre, slightly thinned at its diagonals, makes the louder statement, while Arvo steadies the rest (a coffee roaster for outdoorsy, say), better with brief copy.
